english.title: Manufacturer fail to draw up a single declaration of conformity - category F1/F2/F3 firework
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) was the manufacturer of a category

(A)_[F1]_
(B)_[F2]_

firework subject to an instrument requiring a declaration of conformity to be drawn up, namely **(..SPECIFY THE INSTRUMENTS..), and failed to draw up a single declaration of conformity
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 9(3), 62(1)(d) and 63(1)(a) of the Pyrotechnic Articles (Safety) Regulations 2015.
